description: Charged funding rates of one coin across all exchanges where it trades, normalized to %/hour on a common hourly grid (up to 90 days back). Shows whether the cross-exchange spread is sustained (feeds a hedged pair) or a one-off spike. Returns the curves plus the median and maximum spread.
